purpose: Exploratory, no external data: which components of the Stage 4B dopamine-depletion setting raise GPi firing, and which added changes would lower it?
depletion: parkinsonian/protocol.json dopamine_depletion (components switched on or off; cortical gains do not act on spontaneous activity)
metrics: heldout/protocol.json metrics block (same windowed functions); GPi rate, ISI CV and 8-15 Hz unit index; GPe, STN, D1 and D2 rates

statistics.effect: per seed, median over cells in the condition minus in the normal state; mean over seeds with a 5000-replicate seed bootstrap 95% interval

interpretation_rules: Component contributions are read from the single-component conditions and from pd_full minus each leave-one-out condition.
A condition lowers GPi firing when its interval lies below 0 and the mean change is at most -1 Hz (the Stage 4B and held-out rate margin).
Every outcome is a hypothesis about the model. Settings that match the size of the DANDI:000947 decrease are fitted to used data and are not counted as validation.
Effects of each condition on GPe and STN rates and on GPi regularity are reported so a hypothesis can later be tested on more than the GPi rate.
